info.title: iapolitique API
info.description: API de la plateforme iapolitique : dépôt, filtrage, analyse et classement d'idées pour réduire les dépenses ou augmenter les recettes publiques.

post.summary:
Puts every idea whose analysis failed back in the queue (`analysis_failed →
queued_analysis`, trigger `admin`), oldest first, 500 per request; one admin action
`idea.reanalyze_failed` with their identifiers.

Accepts a refused idea, whoever refused it (§8): it resumes the pipeline (duplicate
detection, then analysis), an idea that was published keeping its slug.

Hides a published idea (`hidden_reason = admin`): it leaves the portal and the next exports;
its author sees the masking on the tracking page and may ask for a human review.

Queues a new analysis (trigger `admin`, §5.7): of a published or hidden idea (it stays
visible with its current analysis until the new one replaces it), or of an idea whose
analysis failed (`analysis_failed → queued_analysis`).

Refuses an accepted idea, published or not (§8): it leaves the site and the exports at
once, its queued jobs are cancelled, its author sees a refusal decided by the
administrator (not automated) and it is purged 30 days later (§7.3).

409.description: Idée ni acceptée ni publiée ni masquée (`idea_not_rejectable`).

post.summary:
Queues a dead job again (attempts reset, due now). A dead screening or second opinion
leaves its text waiting: retrying it resumes the pipeline. A dead analysis left its idea in
`analysis_failed`, which the job ignores: retrying it also moves the idea back to
`queued_analysis`, as « Relancer l'analyse » of the idea does.

code.description:
`mistral_auth`: Mistral refuses the API key (HTTP 401 or 403); the jobs concerned wait
(no attempt consumed) until the first accepted call ends it.
`mistral_reasoning_unsupported`: a configured model refuses `reasoning_effort` (§6.1);
its calls go without it, nothing waits; it ends when the model changes or takes it.

`prompt_version`, `reviewed_at`) and `reports` (`reason`, masked `details`,
`reported_at`; never the reporter's contact); `backfilled: true` for an escalation
sealed by the migration. Plain text only: never render it as HTML.

IdeaStatus.description:
Lifecycle of an idea.

```text
submitted ─▶ screening ─┬─▶ rejected ─▶ purged (or accepted: overturned by the admin)
                        ├─▶ second_opinion ─▶ rejected | accepted
                        ├─▶ accepted ─▶ dedup ─┬─▶ merged
                        │                      └─▶ queued_analysis ─▶ analyzing ─┬─▶ published ⇄ hidden ─▶ purged
                        │                                                        └─▶ analysis_failed ─▶ queued_analysis
                        └─▶ submitted (decision service unavailable, retried by a job)
published | hidden ─▶ withdrawn (deleted by its author) ─▶ purged (12 months later)
```

Re-analyses of a published (or hidden) idea do not change its status: the idea stays
visible with its current analysis until the new one replaces it.

personal_data_masked.description: Personal data was masked automatically (`[donnée masquée]`).

`/suivi#<token>`.

reason_message.description: Refusal explanation in French, with an invitation to rephrase.

oneOf.description: Statement of reasons of a refusal (DSA art. 17).

TargetKind.description: Kind of entity screened by the decision model or reachable through a tracking link.

TaxonomyItem.description: An entry of a taxonomy list.

TrackedIdea.description: Published idea concerned by the tracked text.

status.description:
Status of the text (`domain::status`: `submitted`, `second_opinion`, `accepted`,
`published`, `rejected`…), or `deleted` once erased by its author.

oneOf.description:
Published idea: the idea itself, the idea a duplicate was merged into, or the idea
concerned by a contribution or a report.
Statement of reasons of an automated decision against the text (refusal, masking).
Outcome of the AI review of a report.

TrackedReviewRequest.description: Human review requested by the author.

token.description: Tracking token (43 base64url characters), from the fragment of the tracking link.

YesNoLabels.description: Answers of a yes/no criterion, as described to the decision model.
